# Abilities Detected by "Has Status"

Source: [wiki article 2698](../archive/2698.md); edited 2024-08-31.

<a id="wiki-2698-n1"></a>

- The retained matrix maps Has Status results to abilities. Source-reported verification uses import code YFPB7.

<a id="wiki-2698-n2"></a>

- Respawn areas are documented as Phased Out; Accretion and Earthshatter as both Knocked Down and Stunned; Blizzard as Stunned.

<a id="wiki-2698-n3"></a>
